message:
fix(ka-pc r2, WIP): Codex N1-N6 and D1/D2 in the shell, the viewer and the channel (built, not yet run)

- N1 the list-return keep is decided per PC (its own, connected, normally closed session), not by the newest
  operation; the connected mark is cleared on every way out
- N2 one count of logical PCs (ordinary + kept, at most three), one staged candidate that counts and evicts only
  when it is ready; a new ordinary PC beside three visible ones is refused; the recent order moves on a real
  connect, not when a window closes
- N3 a per-card "연결 해제" (page -> releaseKept -> Release), suppression of the automatic keep until the user
  connects to that PC
- N4 the owner fence: a cancel after the session is established cuts input and the clipboard and closes the
  window through WM_CLOSE; a session cancelled before its window or as its connect finishes never starts; the
  terminate fallback only after 8 s
- N5 Channel::Close repeats its cancel until each thread is done and starts no I/O past the deadline; finished
  reapers are joined at the next ending; a race test with the orderings one cancel misses
- N6 SessionEnded.connected is the real connect (handshake + control), not the socket take; activation messages
  must carry the current op; an Activate that could not be sent leaves no activeOp; the card says connecting/active
- D1/D2 returning is a display interval, not a grant proof (comment, card text); the unconfirmed budget holds
  only the automatic keep, an explicit connect clears it; no 'PC update needed' diagnosis
